scientific_question: In the FireFlow room flow field, choose a criterion for identifying high-speed locations and a measure of regional strength. Treat mesh-connected retained locations as one contiguous high-speed flow region, select the strongest region, and report its strength and its location as the mean spatial location of its retained high-speed locations. Treat locations that share an unstructured-mesh cell as connected. Define speed as the Euclidean magnitude of the stored uvw vector at each point.
